name: paint-with-references
title_zh: 先打铅笔稿、等你点头才上色的协作画布
tagline_zh: 你看着它一笔一笔起稿，中途随时插话改方向，不满意就不进入渲染；不是丢一句 prompt 等一张成品图。
tagline_en: You watch every pencil stroke land, comment mid-sketch to redirect, and nothing gets rendered until you approve.
desc_en: Draw and paint in Codesketch with the native paint CLI, using inspected visual references, pencil construction, and user comments before final rendering. Use for collaborative painting sessions where the user wants to watch actual drawing develop and approve the sketch.
why_zh: 它先检查参考图、再走铅笔结构，最后才渲染，把「画」拆成你能插手的阶段。
why_en: It inspects references, builds in pencil, renders last — splitting drawing into stages you can actually interrupt.
limit_zh: 只在 Codesketch 的原生 paint CLI 里跑，没有这个环境就完全用不了；产物停在画布上的图。
limit_en: Runs only inside Codesketch's native paint CLI; no PSD or layered export, and it stalls on the sketch until you reply.
title_en: A collaborative canvas that pencils first and waits for.
